clauses.quote: The teaching load for secondary teachers shall not exceed six teaching periods a day.
clauses.subject_text: The teaching load for secondary teachers

clauses.quote: The normal teaching assignment for secondary teachers is not more than three teaching preparations and not more than two subject areas.
clauses.subject_text: The normal teaching assignment for secondary teachers

clauses.quote: The seventh period shall be used for consultation, preparation, or for other professional purposes.

Class-free planning and preparation time shall be used by teachers for planning and preparation activities, with the objective of improving instruction, meeting the needs of individual children, and improving the coordination of school programs and activities.
An increase in elementary planning and collaboration time will be added to the one (1) hour and 45 minutes per week currently allotted to teachers.
clauses.subject_text: An increase in elementary planning and collaboration time

clauses.quote: Each teacher will be given an additional 45-minute block of time weekly
two times per month will be dedicated to teacher planning time
two times per month will be for collaboration time.
In the event that the 45-minute planning time falls during an assembly, or other scheduled activities, the principal will arrange coverage for the teacher’s students
This will be accomplished without burdening another teacher for supervision.
